en: This is a black and white postcard, divided into four panels, each showing scenes of an outdoor event. The top left panel features a decorative entrance gate with two towers. The top right panel shows a crowd scene, with people, flags, and a bandstand or pavilion. The bottom two panels depict groups of people, possibly athletes or performers, assembled in formation with a large audience in the background. The text at the center reads: 'Mindekort en Centralstevnet, Hamar 1907.'
